newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAD CONSOLIDATES PHARMACEUTICAL BUSINESSES.
newsitem.headline: SAD CONSOLIDATES PHARMACEUTICAL BUSINESSES.

text.p: South African Druggists Ltd (SAD) said on Wednesday it had consolidated all its pharmaceutical businesses under Pharmacare Ltd, which could have an annual turnover of around 850 million rand.
Kobus Nel, Pharmacare's chief executive, said the group was now a focused business under a single management structure and would strive to make medicines more affordable.
"The company is serious about making medicines more freely available and affordable in a market which will be increasingly driven by cost containment and affordability," Nel said.
He said that the group was well positioned to show continued growth despite increased international competition. Pharmacare would soon embark on an offshore expansion drive, Nel said.
"(We) are on the threshold of a major thrust into new international markets and appropriate resources will be made available to take advantage of the most attractive opportunities," he said.

SAD earlier this week announced its Healthcare Management Services division had bought out the minority shareholders in its Medicross Clinic Chain and Medical Services Organisation unit for an undisclosed sum.
